sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Aspidosperma quebracho-blanco is an evergreen tree of the South American Chaco and neighbouring dry forests. Reported heights vary from about 4 to 26 m between references and sites. It has simple leathery leaves and paired woody follicles that open to release winged seeds.

sections.title: Wood and uses
sections.text: The dense, durable timber is a documented use. Traditional bark remedies are also reported, but this does not establish medical efficacy or safe self-treatment. The plate's simple foliage and open follicles with winged seeds fit the species.
